annotations.title: Ask to send an in-app event to App Review

description: Asks to send a ready event (ploa_events_get says what it still needs) to App Review, in a review submission of its own. Submitting is the owner's decision: from an agent it waits for a person's approval in Ploa (check with ploa_approval_status). Once Apple approves it, the App Store shows it on its dates. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
